pages.text: Build a route from a chest to a barrel. Use the connection menu at each end.

At the chest, enable Extract and choose Green. Set extraction to Always Active for this test. At the barrel, enable Insert on Green and turn Extract off. Put a few items in the chest to watch them arrive.

Stock Basic moves up to 32 items per 20 ticks, Energetic up to 64 per 20 and Vibrant up to 64 per 10. A mixed route can be limited by a slower segment. The conduit tooltip reports its configured rate.

pages.title: Legacy Speed Upgrades
pages.text: Older worlds can retain Legacy Extraction Speed Upgrades. They fit the dedicated extraction slot and set that endpoint’s rate. New worlds can craft a higher conduit tier.
